column3: “Chief commander” (Rabshakeh) is kept as a name.
“I say only a word of lips” is rendered “Your counsel … are only empty words,” following the parallel reading “you say.”
NASB supplies “to all who rely on him.”
“Make a wager” is rendered “make a bargain.”
“Without Yahweh” is rendered “without the Lord's approval.”
“Make a blessing with me” is rendered “Make your peace with me.”
